qualification_notes: Earlier passing full suites were repeated after fixed candidate weighting, JSON digest and zero-budget refinements. Only the final backend-full.log/XML and final browser/source checks qualify the recorded commit. Preliminary passing reports are retained separately.

Candidate CV is post-selection development evidence. It cannot establish independent or confirmatory performance; fixed candidate class weights are disclosed separately from initial fold-local automatic weights.

Receipts are native controller records and corruption checks, not signatures or authorization. Recorded XGBoost/LightGBM effective parameters are supplied fitter parameters, not a resolution of every library default.
